added.summary: Shared CLDR decimal grouping, fraction precision, signs and native digits on both hosts; messages and core data, feedback and HUD components use the same formatter. formatCompact accepts optional fraction precision. DateStyle adds monthYear, monthName, weekday and weekdayShort; DurationStyle adds clock and narrow short cooldown labels. pseudo/en-XA expand formatting, and ar-XB also uses RTL direction and isolation.

breaking.change: Default separators and compact units now follow the active locale and CLDR precision, instead of hard-coded English grouping and three significant digits. Calendars use CLDR headings and weekday labels by default.
breaking.fix: Set decimals for fixed precision, group/point for explicit custom separators, or monthNames/weekdayNames/weekdayShort for game-authored calendar names. Omit these overrides to follow locale switches.
